name: Interaction with Execution-Related Registry Keys
description: An interaction was detected with a registry key that can control or hijack process execution (e.g., IFEO, AppInit_DLLs, COM CLSID). This feature flags potent locations for further analysis.

action.description: Interaction detected with a powerful execution-related registry key. Potential for process hijacking or DLL injection.

operational_usage: These keys are extremely powerful. While legitimate installers (especially for shell extensions or debuggers) might touch them, any modification by scripts or user-land processes requires immediate investigation.
false_positive: Can occur during installation of development tools, drivers with shell extensions, or some security software. SIEM needs to filter based on process reputation and context.
